GEOGRAPHY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.
   B. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Rocks as rumours only.
   D. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.

4. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.
   C. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.
   D. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.

6. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.
   C. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Energy as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.
   B. Treat Industry as rumours only.
   C. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.
   B. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.

10. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Mining as rumours only.
   B. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.
   D. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.
   B. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Folding as rumours only.
   D. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Rocks and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
